title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Liquid Web /…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Gutenberg Blocks by Kadence Blocks plugin up to version 3.9.1.1. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of affected users. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 6.5.
